nodes.name: Voicebot Config
nodes.notes: The one place to change limits, models and the voice. dailyTurnCap is the ElevenLabs daily turn cap.

nodes.name: Normalize Request
nodes.notes: Parses multipart fields, sanitizes history (user/assistant only, last N, length cap), measures audio and decides the gate.

nodes.name: Send Turn Response
nodes.notes: Every non-malformed outcome ends here with HTTP 200 and the contract JSON in $json.response.

nodes.name: Transcribe Audio
nodes.notes: ElevenLabs Scribe. Needs the ElevenLabs Header Auth credential (header xi-api-key).

nodes.name: Read Usage Today
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData: the first turn of a day has no row yet, and Apply Daily Cap treats the empty item as zero turns.

nodes.name: Record Usage
nodes.notes: Best effort counter: a failed write must not fail the turn. Concurrent turns can undercount slightly.

nodes.name: Build LLM Request
nodes.notes: System prompt lives here and only here. Facts come from persona_facts; the browser never supplies a system message.

nodes.name: Ask Inception
nodes.notes: Inception mercury-3 via its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Uses the openAiApi credential only for the Bearer key.

nodes.name: Clean Reply
nodes.notes: Strips think tags, markdown and emoji, then caps the spoken text at ttsMaxChars on a sentence boundary.

nodes.name: Synthesize Speech
nodes.notes: ElevenLabs TTS, Flash v2.5, stock voice. No retry on purpose: a failure falls back to the browser voice.

nodes.name: Build Error Record
nodes.notes: Every fallible stage routes its error output here. The stage is derived from $prevNode.name.

parameters.content:
### Receive and guard
Parse multipart, sanitize history, reject malformed or oversized audio.

### Get the question
ElevenLabs Scribe for audio, typed text otherwise. Blank means status empty.

### Daily cap and prompt
Count the turn in usage_log, load persona_facts, build the server-side prompt.

### Answer and speak
Inception mercury-3, clean for speech, ElevenLabs TTS unless capped. TTS failure keeps status ok with no audio.

### Failures
Any failed stage answers status error (HTTP 200) and writes error_log.
